messages:
carmen.h: quick heads-up — planning a blue->green traffic slice tonight for the embeddings-router in eu-west at 01:00-01:30 UTC. low-risk window, but want ops eyes. release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/2026/emb-router-2.4
ben.t: SGTM. what's the intended slice progression? 5/25/50/100 or something slower?
alice.nguyen: prefer 3-step: 10 -> 40 -> 100 with 5m probe holds. keep 0.5% of traffic pinned to old until final.
carmen.h: ok 10/40/100 it is. canary probes: latency p95 + error rate + token loss. thresholds: p95 <= 120ms, errors < 0.5%, token drop rate < 0.05. if breach, immediate rollback to blue.
dave.k: adding an extra safety net — router will do a socket-level drain for 30s on cohort shifts. also enabling circuit-breaker threshold at the LB to avoid meltdown.
infra-oncall: I'll watch metrics and have runbook open. pager on for the window. tagging svc:edge-lb and svc:router-eu-west.
ben.t: deploy-bot, please schedule the weighted shift and emit preflight checks. include the pinned model version (v2.4.1) in the rollout metadata.
deploy-bot: scheduled weighted-shift job created by @ben.t — job id 89231. plan: 10% @01:05, hold 5m; 40% @01:15, hold 10m; 100% @01:30. pinned-version: model=emb-router:v2.4.1. preflight checks: LB health, backend ready, KV cache warm.
carmen.h: prod-config snippet for routing command (for ops notes):
```
redwood router shift --env=eu-west --from=blue --to=green --steps=10,40,100 --hold=300,600 --drain=30 --pin=emb-router:v2.4.1
```
ben.t: will also pass a temporary fallback policy: fallback_model=emb-router:v2.3.9 if pinned fails. set a 3-minute backoff before retry.
alice.nguyen: small note: enable sampling for request traces at 5% for the first 20m so we can correlate latency spikes to prompts.
deploy-bot: preflight checks completed (all green). LB health: 99.98%; backend ready: instances warmed; KV cache hit rate primed at 88%. starting at 01:05 UTC as scheduled.
infra-oncall: sharing watch dashboard: https://observability.redwood.ai/d/emb-router-eu-west (p95, errors, qps, token-per-request). I'll post interim updates here.
dave.k: if we need to abort, use `redwood router abort-shift --job=89231 --reason="metric breach"` then `redwood router rollto --to=blue --force-drain=60`
carmen.h: agreed. rollback criteria restated: any p95 >150ms sustained for 2 consecutive holds, error >1% in a hold, token loss >0.1% in a hold. also manual abort if sign-off from infra-oncall or SRE.
ben.t: post-deploy checklist: 1) confirm traffic at 100% for 30m 2) run smoke evals for top-50 prompts 3) unpin old version after 24h 4) update release notes with final metrics
alice.nguyen: I'll run the smoke eval job 90021 and attach results. plan to post a short scoreboard at +30m.
deploy-bot: shift reached 10% @01:05 UTC. hold timer started (5m).
infra-oncall: +1 just saw the first traces come in, p95 112ms, errors 0.12%. no alerts.
deploy-bot: hold completed, moving to 40% @01:15 UTC.
dave.k: watching socket drains, no connection churn spikes.
deploy-bot: reached 40% @01:15 UTC. hold timer started (10m).
alice.nguyen: smoke evals running now; first batch 25/25 pass.
infra-oncall: p95 baseline 118ms, small tail variance but within threshold.
carmen.h: if everything stays clean we'll finalize at 01:30. remember to update the console rollout notes with the pinned version and fallback.
ben.t: also note customer C has a long-lived session cohort — set affinity-exception to keep them pinned to blue until final confirmation. I've set cookie rule: session-cookie= retain-blue for cohort id 82.
deploy-bot: reached 100% @01:30 UTC. monitoring for 30m.
alice.nguyen: smoke evals all good 50/50 pass. posting results: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/90021/report
infra-oncall: 30m into 100% and metrics look stable. marking as success if still green at +60m.
dave.k: unpin schedule set: `redwood router unpin --env=eu-west --model=emb-router:v2.3.9 --after=24h`
carmen.h: nice job team — thanks for the careful coordination. I'll update the release notes and close the change window. :tada:
ben.t: closing notes: no rollback needed, no customer-facing incidents. will follow up with perf delta numbers tomorrow.
deploy-bot: job 89231 completed successfully. audit log: https://audit.redwood.ai/jobs/89231
infra-oncall: archived watch. good job.
